messages:
deploy-bot: Started rollout of release/2026.03.15-stream-proxy to service/streaming-proxy in prod (region: us-west-2). diff: routing+healthcheck tweaks.
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: service.streaming-proxy p95 latency spike > 1.2s and increase in 502 rate. Triggered by healthcheck failures. PagerDuty incident created: INC123456.
Maya Chen: acked INC123456 on PagerDuty. Looking now.
Alex Kim: seeing a large number of backend 502s from streaming-proxy pods, stack shows `upstream read error` to auth-cache. rolling logs:
```
streaming-proxy-0 | ERROR upstream read error: read tcp 10.2.1.7:443->10.3.5.9:52432: i/o timeout
streaming-proxy-1 | WARN healthcheck probe failed: status=502
```
Samir Patel: note: rollout touched the new route-mapping code that adds a header strip. Could be interacting badly with our auth-cache keepalive.
Priya Rao: customer telemetry: multiple hosted customers reported truncated streams and aborted connections around 15:12 PDT. Spike correlates with deploy start at 15:11. Impact appears to be user-facing for streaming endpoints (chat streaming + audio streaming).
Maya Chen: quick impact call: is this severe enough to rollback? I vote rollback to previous revision if we see continued 502s after 2 more minutes.
Alex Kim: trying to curl the auth-cache from the pod: `kubectl exec -c proxy streaming-proxy-0 -- curl -svS https://auth-cache.internal/health` -> times out intermittently. Also seeing increased connection resets on node egress.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC123456 -> escalated to SRE Lead (Samir Patel) after 2min no ack by primary.
Samir Patel: on it. grabbing logs from node level to check for socket reuse issues. Also spinning a debug pod to test header variations.
Maya Chen: rolling traffic back from the new replica set to previous by setting deployment image back and pausing rollout: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/streaming-proxy --to-revision=3`
Alex Kim: started rollback command at 15:16 PDT. Watching rollout status.
Alex Kim: status: `deployment "streaming-proxy" rolled back to revision 3`
Maya Chen: monitoring metrics: p95 latency dropping, 502 rate decreasing. Customer-reported errors dropping off.
Priya Rao: sending a proactive note to customers in impacted region: "We're aware of transient streaming failures in US-WEST-2 following a deployment. We've rolled back and are monitoring. We'll post an update in 30 mins."
Maya Chen: good. We should also patch the deployment config to increase readiness probe timeout before reattempting. Add to backfill.
Samir Patel: confirmed from node logs: connection resets to auth-cache coincided with increased socket TIME_WAITs after header change caused backend to open new connections per request (no keepalive). I'll open a PR to revert header change and add keepalive.
Oncall Bot: reminder: handoff in 50 minutes to night oncall. Assigning follow-up to Samir and Priya for a postmortem.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC123456 -> acknowledged by Maya Chen, incident status: mitigated (rollback applied).
Maya Chen: final checklist before I leave thread: 1) confirm all nodes healthy 2) confirm no customer-facing errors -> looks good 3) add postmortem draft with timeline + config diff. I'll prepare the timeline.
Alex Kim: all streaming-proxy pods on revision 3 and Ready=3/3 in us-west-2. p95 latency back to baseline.
Priya Rao: customers notified. Support queue flagged impacted accounts for follow-up.
Samir Patel: PR opened to revert header-strip and add keepalive + readiness tweak: https://git.internal/r/redwood/stream-proxy/pulls/456 (WIP).
Maya Chen: handing off to Samir for follow-ups. My pager is going offline for rotation in 40m. Samir, you are next.
Samir Patel: taking handoff. I'll run through the post-rollback smoke tests and coordinate CL for fixed rollout.
Oncall Bot: Handoff logged. Next oncall: Samir Patel at 2026-03-15T23:00Z.
Maya Chen: thanks team. Closing incident thread. Will add timeline + customer impact numbers to the postmortem in the docs repo. :white_check_mark:
